entity.name: tenant-login-provider
entity.description: Represents a login identity provider (e.g., Google, GitHub, SAML) configured for a tenant. Enables federated authentication integration.

property.name: uid
property.description: A uid string to identify the entity

property.name: tenant
property.description: The tenant this login provider is configured for.

property.name: name
property.description: A name that identifies this login provider within the tenant.

property.name: source
property.description: The source protocol or system used for authentication (e.g., GOOGLE, GITHUB, SAML).

property.name: disabled
property.description: Indicates if this provider is currently disabled.

property.name: direct-access
property.description: If true, the system will default to this login method without requiring selection.

property.name: public-key
property.description: A public key shared with users to interact with the identity provider.

property.name: private-key
property.description: Private key used internally to validate codes returned by the identity provider.

property.name: certificate
property.description: The provider certificate used for signature verification, if required.

property.name: metadata
property.description: A metadata file required by some providers for configuration (e.g., SAML descriptor).

property.name: oidc-discovery-url
property.description: For source=OIDC: the /.well-known/openid-configuration URL of the external OIDC identity provider. The system will fetch authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, and jwks_uri from this document at startup. public-key holds the OIDC client_id; private-key holds the OIDC client_secret.

property.name: users-enabled-by-default
property.description: Defines whether the users created with this provider are enabled by default.

index.description: There cannot be two login providers with the same name under a single tenant.

action.name: enable
action.description: Enables the login provider and allows users to authenticate with it.

action.name: disable
action.description: Disables the login provider and prevents authentication via this source.

entity.name: user-mfa-recovery-code
entity.description: Single-use MFA recovery codes generated at TOTP enrollment time. Each code is stored as a SHA-256 hash; the raw value is shown to the user only once. A consumed code has used-at set; unused codes have used-at null. All codes for a user are replaced atomically when the user regenerates their recovery set.

property.name: uid
property.description: A uid string to identify the entity

property.name: user
property.description: The user who owns these recovery codes.

property.name: code-hash
property.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw recovery code. The raw code is never stored.

property.name: used-at
property.description: Timestamp when this code was consumed via the MFA recovery step. Null means the code is still valid and unused.

property.name: created-at
property.description: Timestamp when this recovery code was generated.

action.name: consume
action.description: Marks this code as used. Called atomically when a valid code is submitted during MFA recovery. Once used, the code cannot be reused.

entity.name: user-personal-api-key
entity.description: A personal API key (PAT) scoped to a specific user. The raw key is shown to the user only at creation time and is never stored. Subsequent authentication uses the SHA-256 hash for constant-time comparison.

property.name: name
property.description: A label to identify the key (e.g. 'CI pipeline', 'local dev').

property.name: key-hash
property.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw key. Never stored in plain text.

property.name: scopes
property.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes granted to this key.

property.name: last-used-at
property.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful authentication.

property.name: expires-at
property.description: Optional expiry. Null means the key does not expire.

action.name: touch
action.description: Updates last-used-at on each successful authentication.

action.name: revoke
action.description: Disables the key without deleting it, preserving the audit trail.
